faq.heading: Shutterstock Watermark Remover FAQs
faq.intro: Initial guidance for using this page responsibly.

items.question: Can I remove a Shutterstock watermark from any image?
items.answer: No. Only process an image when you have a valid license or other permission to remove the watermark and use the result.

items.question: What file types can I upload?
items.answer: The current image tool accepts the supported formats and size limits shown in the upload area.

items.question: Should I review the result?
items.answer: Yes. Always check repaired details and confirm that your intended use follows the applicable license.
